server.DELIVERY_ORDER_NOT_FOUND: The delivery is not available in this site. Refresh the list.
server.DELIVERY_TRANSITION_INVALID: The delivery cannot move to that state. Refresh the list.
server.DELIVERY_REFERENCE_INVALID: Select a completed sale without returns and a valid customer in this site.
server.DELIVERY_SALE_ALREADY_LINKED: This sale already has a delivery. Check the queue before continuing.
server.DELIVERY_COURIER_REQUIRED: Assign a courier before dispatching the delivery.
server.RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND: The reservation or table is not available at this site.
server.RESERVATION_SLOT_CONFLICT: The table is occupied or has an overlapping reservation. Review its schedule before trying again.
server.RESERVATION_STATE_INVALID: The reservation cannot perform this action. Review its status, time, assigned table and party size.
server.RESERVATION_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: The party exceeds the assigned table capacity.
server.RESERVATION_TABLE_HELD: This table is held for a reservation. Record its arrival and explicitly select that party, or manage the reservation first.
server.EXTERNAL_ORDER_AUTH_INVALID: The order source could not be authenticated. Check the connector and retry.
server.EXTERNAL_ORDER_INPUT_INVALID: The order cannot be imported. Check its products, units and currency.
server.EXTERNAL_ORDER_STATE_INVALID: The order or its prices changed. Reload and review it before continuing.
server.EXTERNAL_ORDER_NOT_FOUND: The order or connector is not available at this site.
server.EXTERNAL_ORDER_KEY_UNAVAILABLE: Encrypted connector storage is unavailable. Configure the server encryption key first.
server.EXTERNAL_ORDER_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: External orders are temporarily unavailable. Retry the same operation.
